room_used.name: Shield 4 (Labyrinth / Invisible Steps)
room_used.uniqueness: Room 3030 is the only room in castle-data.js with a span of kind 21.

kind_21.meaning: Wall switch at the bottom-left of Room 3030 that temporarily reveals the active column of invisible/vanishing floating steps leading up to the Shield pedestal.

exact_mechanics.trigger: In state 32 (CODE 5:$1e0a-$1efe), if switch timer -$31c(a5) == 0, Duncan is not crouching (!btst #4, $15(a6)), and Action is pressed (btst #2, $14(a6)), $1e1c-$1e26 clears Action and sets -$31c(a5) = -1; otherwise it delegates to normal ground movement via jmp $1f2(a5) -> CODE 2:$0c6c.
timeline_updates: Update 1 (-$31c == -1 -> 1, CODE 5:$1ee4-$1efc): snaps hero X ($c(a6)) to 80 ($50), plays SOUN 29 ($1d, switch click) via $52(a5) at $1ef6, sets -$31c(a5) = 1, and draws Duncan reaching with Data B PPCT 146 ($c8(a4)) frame 0 at (72, 246).

Updates 2..5 (-$31c == 1..4 -> 2..5): draws Duncan PPCT 146 frames from byte table CODE 5:$1e80 (0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 3, 3, 0) while wall switch prop -$394(a5) (Data B PPCT 712) shifts to frame 1 when -$31c >= 3 ($1e52-$1e5c).
Update 6 (-$31c == 5 -> 6, CODE 5:$1ede-$1ee2): sets visibility flag -$33a(a5) = $ff (st.b -$33a(a5)), illuminating the active invisible platforms.

Updates 7..10 (-$31c == 6..9 -> 7..10): finishes Duncan's 10-update switch-pull animation; once -$31c > 10 ($1e30), Duncan regains full ground movement ($1f2(a5)) while -$31c continues counting up in room helper CODE 5:$1d68-$1e08.

Updates 11..19 (-$31c == 11..19): room helper CODE 5:$1db0-$1e08 draws Data B PPCT 700 (-$324(a5)) step-marker sprites over the active step set selected by random mask -$278(a5) while -$33a(a5) != 0, and advances -$31c(a5) by 1 each update ($1dc4).
Update 20 (-$31c == 20, CODE 5:$1ea2-$1eb2 / $1dc6-$1de2): clears -$33a(a5) = 0 (hiding the step markers again) and plays SOUN 29 ($1d) a second time as the switch resets.
Updates 21..24 (-$31c == 21..24 -> 0, CODE 5:$1de4-$1df6): animates wall switch PPCT 712 back to frame 0 and resets -$31c(a5) = 0 when -$31c reaches 24 ($18), allowing the switch to be pulled again.

room_used.uniqueness: Room 4020 is the only room in castle-data.js with spans of kind 37. At room load, floor row y=135 in the floor directory ($0092) points to an empty sentinel ($04b6) until at least one kind-36 lever is pulled.

kind_37.meaning: Unlatched half-bridge trap span at the center chasm (y = 135) of Room 4020: when only one of the two bottom levers has been pulled, stepping onto the extended half-bridge makes Duncan teeter/wobble for 8 updates and then plunge straight through into the chasm.

exact_mechanics.animation: State 52 (CODE 2:$2a30-$2a7e) selects Data B PPCT 152 ($e0(a4), left-facing when $1e(a6) < 0) or Data B PPCT 153 ($e4(a4), right-facing when $1e(a6) >= 0) and steps word index $2c(a6) by +2 each update through word table CODE 2:$2a6e: [0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, -1], drawing at y - 4 without allowing player input ($2a44-$2a68).
exact_mechanics.drop_transition: On the 9th update ($2c(a6) = 16 -> table word $ffff < 0 at $2a4c-$2a50), $2a52-$2a5a sets frame D2 = 4, advances hero's floor-directory cursor $6(a6) by +4 bytes (skipping past y = 135 so Duncan cannot re-catch the bridge), and jumps to CODE 2:$0ba8, which enters vertical freefall state 51 ($33 at $0bc2/$0be6) into the pit at the bottom of Room 4020.

what_they_do: 1. Pressing Action on an unpulled kind-36 span (span.a == 0) while not crouching sets span.a = 1 (CODE 2:$28aa). While span.a > 0, hero state 49 ($28ba-$28f4) animates Duncan pulling the wall lever using byte table CODE 2:$28fa [0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 3, 3, 0].

2. Simultaneously, the paired $2d2 lever object (CODE 4:$24fa-$25bc) sees span.a > 0, plays SOUN 29 ($1d) on tick 1 ($2542), advances span.a each update up to 4 ($2550-$2556), and on completion sets span.a = -1 (permanently pulled, $2558), switches the lever sprite to pulled frame 1 ($256c), draws its half of the center bridge at y = 141 using Data B PPCT 715 ($2574-$257c), and calls $3ea(a5) with d0 = $22 (Stbl index 17 = 0 points in all 4 Stbl resources, $2580-$2584).

3. At CODE 4:$2588-$25a8, $2d2 inspects the OTHER kind-36 lever's span.a via adda.w $8(a4), a4 ($8(a4) = ±$d8): if the other lever is NOT yet pulled (span.a >= 0), it calls $462(a5) (CODE 5:$67b6) with d7 = 0 (left only) or d7 = 1 (right only), patching the y = 135 floor-directory slot ($92(a0)) to collapsing kind-37 span row $046e or $0492. Once BOTH levers are pulled (other span.a < 0), $2598 sets d7 = 2 and calls $462(a5) ($67d4), patching $92(a0) to solid bridge row $044a ([1116, 231, 258, kind=35, a=2, b=249, c=102]).

do_they_matter_to_toppling_the_black_kni.why: Strictly required. Toppling the Black Knight requires setting all 5 bits (bits 0..4, mask $1f) of the throne pillar-lever bitmask -$399(a5) / $18(a6) (checked at CODE 2:$2832 cmpi.b #$1f, -$399(a5) -> state 50 victory sequence $2904, and in Black Knight $2da at CODE 4:$2668 / $2bf0-$2c0e). Those 5 bits come from span.a of the five kind-35 pillar-lever spans in Room 4020: bit 0 (x=33..53, y=40), bit 1 (x=150..170, y=255), bit 2 (x=231..258, y=135), bit 3 (x=316..336, y=255), and bit 4 (x=439..459, y=40). Pillar lever 2 (span.a = 2, setting bit 2 = $04) exists ONLY on floor row $044a (span 1116 at y = 135), which is spliced into the room's active floor directory ONLY when $462(a5) is called with d7 = 2 — i.e., after BOTH kind-36 levers have been pulled. With 0 or 1 kind-36 levers pulled, span 1116 is unreachable in the floor table (standing at x=231..258, y=135 either misses the floor completely or hits collapsing kind-37 spans 1152/1188), so bit 2 of -$399(a5) can never be set and the Black Knight cannot be toppled.
